name: WPC Order Fulfillment Checklist for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Order Fulfillment Checklist adds a structured, interactive checklist directly inside each WooCommerce order. Shop managers can tick off each fulfillment step (verify stock, print packing slip, pack items, hand off to shipper, enter tracking code) and never miss a step again.

A compact progress bar is shown in the orders list so you can see at a glance which orders are fully processed and which still need attention.

Key Features

  • Fulfillment checklist inside every order detail page
  • Default steps: Verify stock → Print packing slip → Pack items → Contact shipper → Hand off → Enter tracking code
  • Fully customizable steps — add, remove, rename, reorder from Settings
  • AJAX-powered: checkboxes save instantly without page reload
  • Progress bar and X/Y counter in the order detail page
  • Compact mini progress bar in the WooCommerce orders list
  • Reset checklist button per order
  • Optional auto-reset when order status changes back to Processing
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Compatible with legacy post-based order storage

Need more features?

Please try other plugins from us:

  • WPC Order Notes for WooCommerce
  • WPC Order Test for WooCommerce
  • WPC Backend Order Filter for WooCommerce
  • WPC AJAX Add to Cart
  • WPC Added To Cart Notification
sections.installation:
1. Please make sure that you installed WooCommerce
  2. Go to plugins in your dashboard and select “Add New”
  3. Search for “WPC Order Fulfillment Checklist”, Install & Activate it
  4. Now you can go to WP-admin >> WPClever >> Order Fulfillment Checklist to configure
